h1.en: Keep HBT80 16 Concrete Pump under “Advantages with the Doppler Effect Ultrasonic Flow meter” without new ratings

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for HBT80 16 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump. Its weight cell is 6000 kg. HBT8018 prints HBT8018-132S. Both are 1750 mm wide and 1800 mm high. Do not pull Electric 80 into the 6500 kg pair. HBT80-16 prints HBT80-1816-110, shared with Electric 80. Both print pipe 100 / 125 mm, aggregate 4 cm and below and 40 MPa. A shipping weight of 6500 kg matches two pages at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. HBT8018 prints 132 kW, 60 m³/h, conveying 150 m, height 450 m and 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm. HBT80-16 prints 110 kW, 50 m³/h, horizontal 120 m, height 360 m and 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm. The section title “The Doppler Effect Ultrasonic Flow meter” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是6500 kg 印在两张 HBT80 页面上，并不能选定其中一张的数字。要打开的行是 /products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump。HBT80-16。它的重量格是 6000 kg。不要把电动80拉进 6500 kg 这一对。HBT8018 印 HBT8018-132S。两者都是宽 1750 mm、高 1800 mm。6500 kg 的运输重量在河北品锦机械（邢台）对上两页。HBT80-16 印 HBT80-1816-110，与电动80共享。两者都印管径 100 / 125 mm、骨料 4 cm 及以下和 40 MPa。HBT80-16 印 110 kW、50 m³/h、水平 120 m、高度 360 m、6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm。HBT8018 印 132 kW、60 m³/h、输送距离 150 m、高度 450 m、6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm。节标题「多普勒效应 超声流量 计」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。
